class.name: RailMiniMap
class.brief_description: A map of the rails around the camera, seen from above.
class.description: Draws the tracks of [TrackServer] around the active [Camera3D], turned with it while [member follow_camera_rotation] is on: the active branch of each switch in [member switch_active_color], a handle at each switch that a click throws (its name and state as the tooltip), and the rail vehicles of [RailVehicleServer] with somebody aboard or a cabin to drive from, each marked and named. Other vehicles are not drawn. Track names are drawn from a zoom of 2 px/m, switch handles from 0.5 px/m. The tracks' lines are taken once and drawn in one batch through the view's transform; only the tracks around the view are asked for, again when the view leaves them or the tracks change. Hidden, it neither draws nor processes. Being a [Control], it can stand in a HUD window or anywhere in a HUD ([code]addons/libreloaded/minimap/rail_mini_map.tscn[/code] adds the zoom buttons).

method.name: zoom_in
method.description: Zooms in by a step of 1.2.

method.name: zoom_out
method.description: Zooms out by a step of 1.2.
